problems.title: Problem 1: Markup and Discount Sequence
problems.prompt: A boutique buys a jacket wholesale for $\$60$. They mark up the price by $40\%$. During a weekend clearance sale, they discount the retail price by $25\%$. Find the final sale price and the store's net profit.
problems.problem: A boutique buys a jacket wholesale for $\$60$. They mark up the price by $40\%$. During a weekend clearance sale, they discount the retail price by $25\%$. Find the final sale price and the store's net profit.
problems.hint: Retail price $= 60 \times 1.40$. Clearance price $= \text{Retail} \times (1 - 0.25)$. Net profit $= \text{Sale Price} - 60$.

problems.title: Problem 2: Simple Interest Formula
problems.prompt: An investor deposits $\$2,400$ into a savings bond earning $3.5\%$ simple annual interest for $5$ years. Calculate the total interest earned and the final account balance using $I = Prt$.
problems.problem: An investor deposits $\$2,400$ into a savings bond earning $3.5\%$ simple annual interest for $5$ years. Calculate the total interest earned and the final account balance using $I = Prt$.
problems.hint: $I = Prt$, where $P = 2400$, $r = 0.035$, and $t = 5$. Total Balance $= P + I$.

problems.title: Problem 3: Percent Error Calculation
problems.prompt: A student estimates the length of a desk to be $120\text{ cm}$. The actual measured length is $128\text{ cm}$. Calculate the percent error of the estimation to the nearest tenth of a percent.
problems.problem: A student estimates the length of a desk to be $120\text{ cm}$. The actual measured length is $128\text{ cm}$. Calculate the percent error of the estimation to the nearest tenth of a percent.
problems.hint: $\text{Percent Error} = \frac{|\text{Experimental} - \text{Actual}|}{\text{Actual}} \times 100\%$.
